description: This file is the main script for a bot that utilizes Nvidia TTS (Text-to-Speech) service and a pipeline framework to handle audio streaming through various transport mechanisms. It sets up environment variables, configures transport parameters, defines the core asynchronous run function, and initializes the bot's main entry point.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a pipeline task combining a sequence of processing stages with a timeout setting.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a sequence of processing steps for the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles the execution of the pipeline, including handling signals.

classes.name: EndFrame
classes.description: A frame indicating the end of a sequence in the pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: A frame used for speaking text via TTS.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket transport over FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and pipeline runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point function for the bot that initializes transport and starts the bot routine.
